---
name: PR Test Comment
description: Create, update, and archive the "Test this PR" uvx comment on a pull request.
author: Kaj Kowalski
branding: { icon: message-square, color: blue }

inputs:
  cli-name:
    description: "Console script to run through `uvx`. Defaults to the repository name."
    default: ""
  python-version:
    description: "Python version passed as `uvx -p`. Empty omits the flag."
    default: ""
  cli-examples:
    description: "Example commands for the collapsed section; `{cmd}` expands to the `uvx` invocation."
    default: ""
  github-token:
    description: "Token with `issues:write` and `pull-requests:write`."
    default: ${{ github.token }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Create, update, or archive PR comment
      uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9
      env:
        CLI_NAME: ${{ inputs.cli-name }}
        PYTHON_VERSION: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
        CLI_EXAMPLES: ${{ inputs.cli-examples }}
      with:
        github-token: ${{ inputs.github-token }}
        script: |
          const { default: comment } = await import(`${process.env.GITHUB_ACTION_PATH}/pr-comment.mjs`);
          return await comment({ core, context, github });

---
name: Version Check
description: Check out the repository, sync uv, and verify that the package version matches the pushed version tag or manually requested dry-run version.
author: Kaj Kowalski
branding: { icon: tag, color: blue }

inputs:
  package:
    description: "Workspace package to check. Empty checks the root package."
    default: ""
  tag-prefixes:
    description: "Comma-separated prefixes stripped from the tag or requested version before comparing."
    default: v

outputs:
  name:
    description: "Package name reported by `uv version`."
    value: ${{ steps.fields.outputs.name }}
  version:
    description: "Package version reported by `uv version`."
    value: ${{ steps.fields.outputs.version }}
  pypi_url:
    description: "PyPI project URL for this version."
    value: ${{ steps.fields.outputs.pypi_url }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
    - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
      with: { install_args: uv python }
    - run: uv sync
      shell: bash
    - id: check
      uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9
      env:
        PACKAGE: ${{ inputs.package }}
        TAG_PREFIXES: ${{ inputs.tag-prefixes }}
      with:
        result-encoding: json
        script: |
          const { default: checkVersion } = await import(`${process.env.GITHUB_ACTION_PATH}/version-check.mjs`);
          return await checkVersion({ core, context, exec });
    - id: fields
      shell: bash
      env: { RESULT: "${{ steps.check.outputs.result }}" }
      run: jq --raw-output 'to_entries[] | "\(.key)=\(.value)"' <<< "${RESULT}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: Codegen drift check
on:
  pull_request:
  push: { branches: [master], paths: [src/kp2bw/bw_api_types.py, specs/vault-management-api.json] }
permissions: {}
jobs:
  changes:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { pull-requests: read }
    outputs: { api: "${{ steps.filter.outputs.api }}" }
    steps:
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@ceb8a2b8f2d89434be7ff52d3de7ec3738c5cc9d # v4.0.3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            api:
              - src/kp2bw/bw_api_types.py
              - specs/vault-management-api.json

  check-bw-api-types:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result == 'skipped' || needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read }
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: uv python }

      - name: Regenerate bw_api_types.py from spec
        run: bash scripts/generate-bw-types.sh

      - name: Fail if generated file has drifted from spec
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code src/kp2bw/bw_api_types.py; then
            echo "::error file=src/kp2bw/bw_api_types.py::Generated file is out of sync with specs/vault-management-api.json. Run 'bash scripts/generate-bw-types.sh' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  codegen:
    needs: [changes, check-bw-api-types]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - shell: bash
        env: { RESULTS: "${{ join(needs.*.result, ' ') }}" }
        run: |
          for result in ${RESULTS}; do
            [[ ${result} == success || ${result} == skipped ]]
          done

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: Container
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      distribution-artifact: { type: string, required: true }
      version: { type: string, required: true }
      attest: { type: boolean, default: false }
      cli: { type: string, default: "", description: "vw or bw; empty validates both" }
permissions: { contents: read }
defaults: { run: { shell: bash } }
env: { MISE_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE: "0s", MISE_NPM_PACKAGE_MANAGER: npm }
jobs:
  changes:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { pull-requests: read }
    outputs: { image: "${{ steps.filter.outputs.image }}" }
    steps:
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@ceb8a2b8f2d89434be7ff52d3de7ec3738c5cc9d # v4.0.3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            image:
              - Dockerfile
              - Dockerfile.dockerignore
              - scripts/release*.sh
              - src/**
              - pyproject.toml
              - uv.lock
              - tests/container_image_test.py
              - tests/Dockerfile.vaultwarden
              - tests/fixtures/**
              - .github/workflows/container.yml
              - .github/workflows/publish.yml

  prepare:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result == 'skipped' || needs.changes.outputs.image == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.version }}
      bw: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.bw }}
      vw: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.vw }}
      python: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.python }}
      node: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.node }}
      server: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.server }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - id: mise
        uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: crane uv python nodejs }
      - if: inputs.distribution-artifact != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: "${{ inputs.distribution-artifact }}", path: dist }
      - if: inputs.distribution-artifact == ''
        run: uv build --no-sources --wheel
      - name: Resolve versions and immutable base images
        id: resolve
        env:
          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          PYTHON_IMAGE: python:${{ steps.mise.outputs.python }}-slim-trixie
          NODE_IMAGE: node:${{ steps.mise.outputs.node }}-trixie-slim
        run: |
          wheels=(dist/kp2bw-*.whl)
          [[ ${#wheels[@]} == 1 && -f ${wheels[0]} ]] || { echo "Expected exactly one kp2bw wheel" >&2; exit 1; }
          metadata=$(unzip -p "${wheels[0]}" '*.dist-info/METADATA')
          name=$(grep -m 1 '^Name: ' <<<"${metadata}")
          version=$(grep -m 1 '^Version: ' <<<"${metadata}")
          version=${version#Version: }
          [[ ${name} == "Name: kp2bw" ]] || { echo "Wheel is not kp2bw" >&2; exit 1; }
          [[ -z ${EXPECTED_VERSION} || ${version} == "${EXPECTED_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "Wheel version ${version} differs from ${EXPECTED_VERSION}" >&2; exit 1; }
          [[ ${version} =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]] || { echo "Unsupported version ${version}" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "version=${version}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          for entry in bw:@bitwarden%2fcli vw:@kjanat%2fvaultwarden-cli; do
            registry=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 "https://registry.npmjs.org/${entry#*:}")
            latest=$(jq -r '.versions | keys[] | select(test("^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"))' <<<"${registry}" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
            echo "${entry%%:*}=${latest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            echo "Resolved ${entry%%:*} CLI ${latest}"
          done
          python_digest=$(crane digest "${PYTHON_IMAGE}")
          node_digest=$(crane digest "${NODE_IMAGE}")
          tags=$(crane ls ghcr.io/dani-garcia/vaultwarden)
          server=$(grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' <<<"${tags}" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
          server_digest=$(crane digest "ghcr.io/dani-garcia/vaultwarden:${server}")
          {
            echo "python=${PYTHON_IMAGE}@${python_digest}"
            echo "node=${NODE_IMAGE}@${node_digest}"
            echo "server=ghcr.io/dani-garcia/vaultwarden@${server_digest}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Smoke test the distribution used by every image
        run: uv run --isolated --no-project --with ./dist/kp2bw-*.whl ./tests/smoke_test.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: "container-wheel-${{ inputs.cli || 'all' }}", path: "dist/kp2bw-*.whl", if-no-files-found: error }

  validate-vw:
    name: &validate-name image (${{ matrix.cli }}, ${{ matrix.arch }})
    needs: prepare
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && inputs.cli != 'bw' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [amd64, arm64]
        cli: [vw]
        include: &runners
          - { arch: amd64, runner: ubuntu-26.04 }
          - { arch: arm64, runner: ubuntu-26.04-arm }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write, attestations: write }
    steps: &validate-steps
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: uv python }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: "container-wheel-${{ inputs.cli || 'all' }}", path: dist }
      - name: Build the disposable server
        env: { SERVER_IMAGE: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.server }}" }
        run: docker build --file tests/Dockerfile.vaultwarden --tag kp2bw-container-fixture
          --build-arg "VAULTWARDEN_IMAGE=${SERVER_IMAGE}" tests
      - name: Run the disposable server
        id: server
        background: true
        env:
          DOMAIN: https://localhost:18443
          I_REALLY_WANT_VOLATILE_STORAGE: true
          ROCKET_PORT: 443
          ROCKET_TLS: '{certs="/ssl/cert.pem",key="/ssl/key.pem"}'
          SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: false
        run: exec docker run --rm --name kp2bw-container-fixture -p 127.0.0.1:18443:443
          -e I_REALLY_WANT_VOLATILE_STORAGE -e SIGNUPS_ALLOWED -e DOMAIN -e ROCKET_PORT -e ROCKET_TLS
          kp2bw-container-fixture
      - name: Check server readiness
        id: server-ready
        background: true
        env: { cacert: tests/fixtures/vaultwarden-certs/cert.pem }
        run: curl -fsS --retry 60 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 --retry-max-time 90 --max-time 5
          --cacert "${cacert}" https://localhost:18443/alive
      - name: Build the production image
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
          CLI_VERSION: ${{ matrix.cli == 'vw' && needs.prepare.outputs.vw || needs.prepare.outputs.bw }}
          CLI_PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.cli == 'vw' && '@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli' || '@bitwarden/cli' }}
          CLI: ${{ matrix.cli }}
          PYTHON_IMAGE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.python }}
          NODE_IMAGE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.node }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: docker build --platform "linux/${ARCH}" --tag "kp2bw-production:${CLI}-${ARCH}"
          --build-arg "KP2BW_VERSION=${VERSION}" --build-arg "CLI_VERSION=${CLI_VERSION}" --build-arg "CLI_PACKAGE=${CLI_PACKAGE}"
          --build-arg "REVISION=${GITHUB_SHA}" --build-arg "PYTHON_IMAGE=${PYTHON_IMAGE}"
          --build-arg "NODE_IMAGE=${NODE_IMAGE}" .
      - wait: server-ready
      - name: Test the actual image
        env:
          KP2BW_CONTAINER_IMAGE: kp2bw-production:${{ matrix.cli }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          KP2BW_CONTAINER_VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
          KP2BW_CONTAINER_BW_VERSION: ${{ matrix.cli == 'vw' && needs.prepare.outputs.vw || needs.prepare.outputs.bw }}
          KP2BW_CONTAINER_CLI_PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.cli == 'vw' && '@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli' || '@bitwarden/cli' }}
          KP2BW_CONTAINER_ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: uv run python tests/container_image_test.py
      - name: Save the tested image
        env: { ARCH: "${{ matrix.arch }}", CLI: "${{ matrix.cli }}" }
        run: docker save "kp2bw-production:${CLI}-${ARCH}" --output "/tmp/container-${CLI}-${ARCH}.tar"
      - name: Attest the tested image archive
        if: inputs.attest
        id: provenance
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with: { subject-path: "/tmp/container-${{ matrix.cli }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar" }
      - if: inputs.attest
        env: { BUNDLE: "${{ steps.provenance.outputs.bundle-path }}", CLI: "${{ matrix.cli }}", ARCH: "${{ matrix.arch }}" }
        run: cp "${BUNDLE}" "/tmp/container-${CLI}-${ARCH}.sigstore.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: container-${{ matrix.cli }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: /tmp/container-${{ matrix.cli }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.*
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 90
      - cancel: server

  validate-bw:
    name: *validate-name
    needs: prepare
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && inputs.cli != 'vw' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [amd64, arm64]
        cli: [bw]
        include: *runners
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write, attestations: write }
    steps: *validate-steps

  container-vw:
    needs: [changes, prepare, validate-vw]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.cli != 'bw' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps: &gate
      - env: { NEEDS: "${{ toJSON(needs) }}" }
        run: |
          jq -e '[.[].result] - ["success", "skipped"] == []
            and [to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("validate-")) | .value.result] == [.prepare.result]' <<<"${NEEDS}"

  container-bw:
    needs: [changes, prepare, validate-bw]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.cli != 'vw' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps: *gate

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://www.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json
---
name: Integration (Docker)
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      lane: { type: string, required: true, description: "bitwarden or vaultwarden" }
permissions: {}
# Compatibility tests must include newly published stable releases.
env: { MISE_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE: "0s", MISE_NPM_PACKAGE_MANAGER: npm }
defaults: { run: { shell: pwsh } }
jobs:
  config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { contents: read }
    outputs: { matrix: "${{ steps.resolve.outputs.matrix }}" }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: crane }
      - name: Discover stable CLI and server releases
        id: resolve
        env: { LANE: "${{ inputs.lane }}" }
        run: |
          $stable = '^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$'
          $registry = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://registry.npmjs.org/@bitwarden%2fcli' -Headers @{ Accept = 'application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' } -TimeoutSec 30
          if ($registry.name -ne '@bitwarden/cli' -or -not $registry.versions) {
            throw 'Invalid Bitwarden CLI registry metadata'
          }
          $cliVersions = @($registry.versions.PSObject.Properties.Name | Where-Object { $_ -match $stable })
          $vwRegistry = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://registry.npmjs.org/@kjanat%2fvaultwarden-cli' -Headers @{ Accept = 'application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' } -TimeoutSec 30
          if ($vwRegistry.name -ne '@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli' -or -not $vwRegistry.versions) {
            throw 'Invalid Vaultwarden CLI registry metadata'
          }
          $newestVw = $vwRegistry.versions.PSObject.Properties.Name | Where-Object { $_ -match $stable } | Sort-Object { [version]$_ } | Select-Object -Last 1
          if (-not $newestVw) { throw 'No stable Vaultwarden CLI release found' }
          $serverTags = & crane ls ghcr.io/dani-garcia/vaultwarden
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Vaultwarden release discovery failed' }
          $serverVersions = @($serverTags | Where-Object { $_ -match $stable })
          $newestCli = $cliVersions | Sort-Object { [version]$_ } | Select-Object -Last 1
          $newestServer = $serverVersions | Sort-Object { [version]$_ } | Select-Object -Last 1
          if (-not $newestCli -or -not $newestServer) { throw 'No stable CLI/server release found' }
          $digest = (& crane digest "ghcr.io/dani-garcia/vaultwarden:$newestServer").Trim()
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $digest -notmatch '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') {
            throw 'Vaultwarden image resolution returned no valid digest'
          }
          $newestImage = "ghcr.io/dani-garcia/vaultwarden@$digest"
          $include = @(
            @{ 'cli-package' = '@bitwarden/cli'; lane = 'bitwarden'; 'bw-version' = $newestCli; 'server-version' = $newestServer; 'server-image' = $newestImage },
            @{ 'cli-package' = '@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli'; lane = 'vaultwarden'; 'bw-version' = $newestVw; 'server-version' = $newestServer; 'server-image' = $newestImage }
          ) | Where-Object { $_.lane -eq $env:LANE }
          if (-not $include) { throw "Unknown lane '$env:LANE'" }
          if ($env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) {
            @('### Resolved compatibility matrix', '', '| Lane | CLI package | CLI version | Vaultwarden | Immutable image |', '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |') |
              Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append -Encoding utf8
            foreach ($row in $include) {
              "| $($row.lane) | $($row.'cli-package') | $($row.'bw-version') | $($row.'server-version') | $($row.'server-image') |" |
                Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append -Encoding utf8
            }
          }
          $weights = [ordered]@{
            golden = 80
            attachment_refresh = 60
            refs = 60
            metadata = 74
            metadata_legacy_ref = 53
            reserved_fields = 38
            ssh_cli = 67
            ssh = 61
            ssh_rotation = 89
            ssh_protected = 64
            checkpoint = 49
            crash_before_upload = 75
            crash_after_upload = 61
            crash_after_mapping = 78
            crash_after_delete = 72
            crash_lost_checkpoint = 84
            crash_orphan_slot = 87
            passkey = 59
            preview = 61
            preview_update = 63
            preview_protected = 68
            preview_resume = 85
            preview_resume_converge = 75
            attachment_batch = 85
            attachment_identity = 74
            attachment_rejected = 66
            attachment_added = 65
            attachment_legacy = 48
            templates_cli = 60
            templates = 70
            templates_selected = 83
            history_archive_cli = 69
            history_archive = 73
            history_updates = 80
            field_limits = 63
            field_limits_org = 80
            scope = 72
            scope_report = 77
            scope_migrate_uris = 79
            scope_strip = 74
            item_selection = 71
            item_selection_force = 63
            item_selection_rejected = 58
            fixups = 77
            fixups_uri_only = 68
            fixups_personal = 70
          }
          $layout = @{
            bitwarden = @{ shards = 12; slots = 4 }
            vaultwarden = @{ shards = 2; slots = 7 }
          }
          $order = @($weights.Keys | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { $weights[$_] }; Descending = $true }, @{ Expression = { $_ } })
          foreach ($row in $include) {
            $count = $layout[$row.lane].shards
            $bins = $count * $layout[$row.lane].slots
            $load = [int[]]::new($bins)
            $members = @(for ($b = 0; $b -lt $bins; $b++) { ,[System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new() })
            foreach ($check in $order) {
              $best = 0
              for ($b = 1; $b -lt $bins; $b++) { if ($load[$b] -lt $load[$best]) { $best = $b } }
              $members[$best].Add($check)
              $load[$best] += $weights[$check]
            }
            $jobs = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt $count; $i++) {
              $job = $row.Clone()
              $job.shard = "$($i + 1)/$count"
              $job.workers = @(for ($b = $i; $b -lt $bins; $b += $count) {
                if ($members[$b].Count) { $members[$b] -join ' ' }
              })
              $job
            })

            "matrix=$matrix" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding utf8
            Write-Host "Matrix:"; $matrix | yq . -P
          }

  unit:
    name: Script regressions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read }
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: uv python nodejs }
      - run: uv run pytest -q tests/test_script_adapters.py
        env: { KP2BW_RUN_NPX_TESTS: "1" }

  e2e:
    name: e2e (${{ matrix.lane }} ${{ matrix.shard }}, ${{ matrix.cli-package }} ${{ matrix.bw-version }}, Vaultwarden ${{ matrix.server-version }})
    needs: [config, unit]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read }
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      BW_CERT_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/tests/fixtures/vaultwarden-certs/cert.pem
      KP2BW_CLI: ${{ matrix.cli-package == '@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli' && 'vw' || 'bw' }}
      KP2BW_SNAPSHOT_GOLDEN: true
      KP2BW_TEST_CLI_PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.cli-package }}
    strategy: { fail-fast: false, matrix: "${{ fromJson(needs.config.outputs.matrix) }}" }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: { persist-credentials: false }

      - name: Build Vaultwarden image
        id: image
        background: true
        shell: bash
        env: { IMAGE: "VAULTWARDEN_IMAGE=${{ matrix.server-image }}" }
        run: docker build --pull
          --build-arg "${IMAGE}"
          -f tests/Dockerfile.vaultwarden
          -t kp2bw-vaultwarden tests

      - parallel:
          - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
            with: { install_args: uv python nodejs }
          - name: Restore ${{ matrix.cli-package }} ${{ matrix.bw-version }}
            id: cli-cache
            uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
            with:
              path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cli
              key: e2e-cli-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.cli-package }}-${{ matrix.bw-version }}

      - run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Install ${{ matrix.cli-package }} ${{ matrix.bw-version }}
        if: steps.cli-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        shell: bash
        env: { CLI_PACKAGE: "${{ matrix.cli-package }}", CLI_VERSION: "${{ matrix.bw-version }}" }
        run: npm install --global --ignore-scripts --prefix "${RUNNER_TEMP}/cli" "${CLI_PACKAGE}@${CLI_VERSION}"

      - name: Put the CLI on PATH
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "${RUNNER_TEMP}/cli/bin" >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/cli/bin/${KP2BW_CLI}" --version

      - wait: image

      - parallel:
          - name: E2E worker 0
            if: matrix.workers[0] != ''
            shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}"
            env: { INDEX: "0", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[0] }}" }
            run: &e2e-worker |
              port=$((18443 + INDEX))
              name="vaultwarden-${INDEX}"

              docker run -d --name "${name}" \
                -p "127.0.0.1:${port}:443" \
                -e I_REALLY_WANT_VOLATILE_STORAGE=true \
                -e SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false \
                -e "DOMAIN=https://localhost:${port}" \
                -e ROCKET_PORT=443 \
                -e 'ROCKET_TLS={certs="/ssl/cert.pem",key="/ssl/key.pem"}' \
                kp2bw-vaultwarden >/dev/null

              curl --retry 30 --retry-all-errors \
                --retry-delay 1 --fail --silent --show-error \
                --insecure --output /dev/null \
                "https://localhost:${port}"

              if [[ ${INDEX} == 0 ]]; then
                docker exec "${name}" /vaultwarden --version
              fi

              read -ra checks <<<"${CHECKS}"

              BW_SERVER_URL="https://localhost:${port}" \
              KP2BW_E2E_VAULTWARDEN_CONTAINER="${name}" \
                uv run --no-sync tests/e2e_vaultwarden_test.py "${checks[@]}"

          - name: E2E worker 1
            if: matrix.workers[1] != ''
            shell: bash
            env: { INDEX: "1", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[1] }}" }
            run: *e2e-worker

          - name: E2E worker 2
            if: matrix.workers[2] != ''
            shell: bash
            env: { INDEX: "2", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[2] }}" }
            run: *e2e-worker

          - name: E2E worker 3
            if: matrix.workers[3] != ''
            shell: bash
            env: { INDEX: "3", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[3] }}" }
            run: *e2e-worker

          - name: E2E worker 4
            if: matrix.workers[4] != ''
            shell: bash
            env: { INDEX: "4", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[4] }}" }
            run: *e2e-worker

          - name: E2E worker 5
            if: matrix.workers[5] != ''
            shell: bash
            env: { INDEX: "5", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[5] }}" }
            run: *e2e-worker

          - name: E2E worker 6
            if: matrix.workers[6] != ''
            shell: bash
            env: { INDEX: "6", CHECKS: "${{ matrix.workers[6] }}" }
            run: *e2e-worker

      - name: Show Vaultwarden logs on failure
        if: failure() || cancelled()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          for name in $(docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' --filter name=vaultwarden-); do
            echo "::group::${name} logs"
            docker logs "${name}"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

  gate:
    needs: [config, unit, e2e]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - shell: bash
        env: { RESULTS: "${{ join(needs.*.result, ' ') }}" }
        run: |
          for result in ${RESULTS}; do
            [[ ${result} == success ]]
          done

---
name: Publish
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v[0-9]*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version: { description: "Version to validate (e.g. v3.10.0)", type: string, required: true }
permissions: {}
concurrency: { group: release-kp2bw, cancel-in-progress: false }
defaults: { run: { shell: bash } }
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: read }
    outputs:
      name: ${{ steps.check.outputs.name }}
      version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.version }}
      pypi_url: ${{ steps.check.outputs.pypi_url }}
      stable: ${{ steps.mode.outputs.stable }}
      dry: ${{ steps.mode.outputs.dry }}
    steps:
      - id: check
        uses: $/.github/actions/version-check
      - id: mode
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.check.outputs.version }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          [[ "${VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] && stable=true || stable=false
          echo "stable=${stable}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          [[ "${EVENT}" == workflow_dispatch ]] && dry=true || dry=false
          echo "dry=${dry}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  draft:
    needs: check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { contents: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
      STABLE: ${{ needs.check.outputs.stable }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - if: needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true'
        run: ./scripts/release.sh draft

  build:
    needs: [check, draft]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: write, id-token: write, attestations: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: uv python }
      - name: Stamp build revision
        env:
          contents: |
            """Release build revision."""

            BUILD_SHA: str | None = "${{ github.sha }}"
          file: src/kp2bw/build_info.py
        run: printf '%s\n' "${contents}" > "${file}"
      - run: uv build --no-sources
      - name: Attest wheel and source distribution
        if: needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true'
        id: provenance
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with: { subject-path: "dist/*" }
      - if: needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true'
        env: { BUNDLE: "${{ steps.provenance.outputs.bundle-path }}" }
        run: cp "${BUNDLE}" dist/distribution.sigstore.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: release-distributions, path: dist/, if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 90 }

  stage-distributions:
    if: needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true'
    needs: [check, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: release-distributions, path: dist }
      - name: Attach distributions and provenance to the draft
        run: ./scripts/release.sh stage

  smoke:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: read }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - parallel:
          - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
            with: { install_args: uv python }
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
            with: { name: release-distributions, path: dist }
      - parallel:
          - name: Smoke test wheel
            run: uv run --isolated --no-project --with ./dist/kp2bw-*.whl ./tests/smoke_test.py
          - name: Smoke test source distribution
            run: uv run --isolated --no-project --with ./dist/kp2bw-*.tar.gz ./tests/smoke_test.py

  vaultwarden:
    needs: draft
    permissions: { contents: read }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/integration-docker.yml
    with: { lane: vaultwarden }

  bitwarden:
    needs: draft
    permissions: { contents: read }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/integration-docker.yml
    with: { lane: bitwarden }

  container-vw:
    needs: [check, build]
    permissions: &container-permissions { contents: read, pull-requests: read, id-token: write, attestations: write }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/container.yml
    with:
      distribution-artifact: release-distributions
      version: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
      attest: ${{ needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true' }}
      cli: vw

  container-bw:
    needs: [check, build]
    permissions: *container-permissions
    uses: $/.github/workflows/container.yml
    with:
      distribution-artifact: release-distributions
      version: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
      attest: ${{ needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true' }}
      cli: bw

  stage-images:
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true' && needs.container-vw.result == 'success' }}
    needs: [check, container-vw, container-bw]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { pattern: "container-*-*", path: images, merge-multiple: true }
      - name: Verify image provenance
        run: for file in ./images/*.tar; do
          gh attestation verify "${file}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --signer-workflow "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/.github/workflows/container.yml" --source-digest "${GITHUB_SHA}"; done
      - name: Attach image archives to the draft
        run: ./scripts/release.sh stage images image-archive-sha256.json

  publish:
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check.outputs.dry != 'true' && !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'skipped') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
    needs: [check, smoke, vaultwarden, stage-distributions, stage-images]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment: { name: pypi-kp2bw, url: "${{ needs.check.outputs.pypi_url }}" }
    permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - parallel:
          - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
            with: { install_args: uv }
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
            with: { name: release-distributions, path: dist }
      - name: Verify provenance before publishing
        run: |
          for file in ./dist/*.whl ./dist/*.tar.gz; do
            gh attestation verify "${file}" \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
              --signer-workflow "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/.github/workflows/publish.yml" \
              --source-digest "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          done
      - name: Check PyPI for conflicting files
        run: ./scripts/release.sh check-pypi
      - name: Publish the tested distributions
        run: uv publish --check-url https://pypi.org/simple/ ./dist/*.whl ./dist/*.tar.gz
      - name: Verify anonymous PyPI downloads
        run: ./scripts/release.sh verify-pypi

  publish-images:
    needs: [check, publish]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'skipped') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions: { contents: write, packages: write, id-token: write, attestations: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
        with: { install_args: crane }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { pattern: "container-*-*", path: images, merge-multiple: true }
      - uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4.7.0
        with: { registry: ghcr.io, username: "${{ github.actor }}", password: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - name: Publish tested image archives
        id: images
        run: ./scripts/release-images.sh publish
      - name: Attest vw image index
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.images.outputs.image }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.vw }}
          push-to-registry: true
      - name: Attest bw image index
        if: steps.images.outputs.bw != ''
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.images.outputs.image }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.bw }}
          push-to-registry: true
      - name: Verify anonymous pulls
        run: ./scripts/release-images.sh verify
      - name: Collect image digests
        run: mkdir -p publication && cp image-digests.json publication/
      - name: Attach image digests to the draft
        run: ./scripts/release.sh stage publication image-index-sha256.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: published-image-digests, path: image-digests.json, retention-days: 90 }

  finalize:
    needs: [check, publish-images]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'skipped') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: write, packages: write }
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.check.outputs.version }}
      STABLE: ${{ needs.check.outputs.stable }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - parallel:
          - uses: jdx/mise-action@6612f0ef07ed2a736cd1e00a94a065522dd41195 # v5.2.5
            with: { install_args: crane }
          - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
            with: { name: published-image-digests, path: . }
      - uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4.7.0
        with: { registry: ghcr.io, username: "${{ github.actor }}", password: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - name: Promote stable aliases
        run: ./scripts/release-images.sh promote
      - name: Publish the draft
        run: ./scripts/release.sh finalize

          ~~~

          $($commands)
          ~~~

          ~~~python
          shutil.which("$env:KP2BW_CLI")
          # $($pyJoinedComments)
          ~~~

          $log

      - name: Run Windows CLI launcher smoke test
        env: { KP2BW_RUN_WIN_CMD_SMOKE: 1 }
        run: uv run tests/windows_bw_cmd_smoke.py

      - name: Check isolated npx bootstrap
        if: matrix.cli == 'vw' && matrix.pm == 'npm'
        run: uv run tests/npx_bootstrap_test.py

ARG KP2BW_VERSION
ARG CLI_VERSION

ARG REVISION
ARG PYTHON_IMAGE
ARG NODE_IMAGE

      org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/kjanat/kp2bw" \

    && useradd --uid 10001 --gid 10001 --create-home kp2bw \
    && mkdir -p /data/bw /data/logs /w \
    && chown -R 10001:10001 /data /w

files.README.md:
# KP2BW - KeePass to Bitwarden Converter Migrates KeePass databases to Bitwarden. -
Encrypted in-memory transfer Data never hits disk unencrypted (except attachments, which are cleaned up after upload).
-
KeePass REF resolution Username/password references are resolved.
Matching credentials merge URLs and a compatible TOTP into one entry. Conflicting TOTP or other content that cannot be merged stays in a separate entry to prevent data loss.
-
Passkey migration KeePassXC FIDO2/passkey credentials (KPEX_PASSKEY_*) are converted to Bitwarden fido2Credentials.
-
Custom properties & attachments Imported as Bitwarden custom fields or attachments (values exceeding Bitwarden’s encrypted field limit auto-upload as files).
-
Long notes handling Notes exceeding Bitwarden’s encrypted field limit are uploaded as notes.txt attachments.
-
Idempotent re-runs that sync changes Safe to run repeatedly; existing entries are updated in place when their KeePass content changed (notes, credentials, URIs, fields) and never duplicated. Each item is stamped with its KeePass UUID in a KP2BW_ID field, so distinct entries that share a title stay separate and a re-run is matched by identity rather than title. Edits you make in Bitwarden are protected: a re-run preserves them instead of reverting to KeePass (a KP2BW_SYNC content stamp tells your edit apart from kp2bw's own writes); --force-update overrides.
Disable updates with --no-update.
-
Nested folders KeePass folder hierarchy is recreated in Bitwarden.
-
Recycle Bin filtering Deleted entries are automatically excluded.
-
Expiry awareness Expired entries are marked [EXPIRED] in notes; optionally skip them entirely with --skip-expired.
-
Metadata preservation KeePass tags and expiry date are folded into a single KP2BW_META custom field (JSON), omitted when an entry has neither. Created/modified timestamps are not migrated. Bitwarden manages its own creation/revision dates.
-
Tag filtering Import only entries matching specific tags.
-
Organization & collection support Upload into a Bitwarden organization with automatic or manual collection assignment.
-
Full UTF-8 & cross-platform Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
> Fork of [jampe/kp2bw]. ## Usage/Installation ```bash # run directly uvx kp2bw@latest # install globally with: uv tool install kp2bw # update with: uv tool update kp2bw kp2bw --version kp2bw passwords.kdbx ``` or from a GitHub URL (pull requests display a ["🧪 Test this PR"] section with convenience commands to run the branch without installing): ```bash # install with: uv tool install git+https://github.com/kjanat/kp2bw kp2bw passwords.kdbx # run directly without installing: uvx --from git+https://github.com/kjanat/kp2bw kp2bw passwords.kdbx ``` The [container image](https://ghcr.io/kjanat/kp2bw:latest) `ghcr.io/kjanat/kp2bw:latest` contains the [Vaultwarden CLI](https://github.com/kjanat/vw/tree/master/apps/cli); `ghcr.io/kjanat/kp2bw:bw` contains the Bitwarden CLI. Password history imports into existing items need the Vaultwarden CLI. ## Prerequisites Install the [Vaultwarden CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli) and log in once. Self-hosted servers need the `config server` step first: ```bash vw config server https://vault.example.com vw login user@example.com vw status ``` After a successful login, `vw status` prints the following; kp2bw unlocks the vault itself on every run: ```json { "serverUrl": "https://vault.example.com", "lastSync": "2026-10-31T12:00:00.000Z", "userEmail": "user@example.com", "userId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "status": "locked" } ``` kp2bw also supports the [Bitwarden CLI]: set `KP2BW_CLI=bw` in your environment or `.env` and run the same three commands with `bw`, which keeps its own login. Without an installed CLI, kp2bw runs `npx --yes @kjanat/vaultwarden-cli@latest`; use that command in place of `vw` for the login steps. ## Usage ```pwsh kp2bw [-h] [-V] [-k PASSWORD] [-K FILE] [-b PASSWORD] [-o ID] [-t TAG [TAG ...]] [-c ID] [--path-to-name | --no-path-to-name] [--path-to-name-skip N] [--skip-expired | --no-skip-expired] [--include-recycle-bin | --no-include-recycle-bin] [--metadata | --no-metadata] [--update | --no-update] [--force-update] [--include-oversize-secrets] [--folder | --no-folder] [--uri-match MODE] [--entry-id UUID] [--item-id UUID] [--preview [text|json]] [--preview-target] [--password-history | --no-password-history] [--archive-history] [--map-templates] [--template-map JSON] [--ssh-map JSON] [--checkpoint PATH] [--fixup] [--totp-pps | --no-totp-pps] [--interpret-uri-syntax | --no-interpret-uri-syntax] [--migrate-uris] [--report-uris SOURCE] [--strip-ids] [-y] [-v] [-d] [FILE] ``` | Flag | Description | Env var | | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | | `keepass_file` | Path to your KeePass 2.x database | `KP2BW_KEEPASS_FILE` | | `-k, --keepass-password` | KeePass password (prompted if omitted) | `KP2BW_KEEPASS_PASSWORD` | | `-K, --keepass-keyfile` | KeePass key file | `KP2BW_KEEPASS_KEYFILE` | | `-b, --bitwarden-password` | Bitwarden password (prompted if omitted) | `KP2BW_BITWARDEN_PASSWORD` | | `-o, --bitwarden-org` | Bitwarden Organization ID | `KP2BW_BITWARDEN_ORG` | | `-c, --bitwarden-collection` | Collection ID, `auto` for top-level folder names, or `nested` for full folder paths | items even if edited in Bitwarden since the last run (default: protect such edits) | `KP2BW_FORCE_UPDATE` | | `--entry-id UUID` | Sync only this KeePass entry; combine with `--force-update` to overwrite just its destination item | - | | `--item-id UUID` | Sync only this existing Bitwarden item | - | | `--preview` | [Preview the `--archive-history` | Archive full KeePass history, including historical secrets, as an attachment (default: off) | `KP2BW_ARCHIVE_HISTORY` | | `--map-templates` | Map KeePass templates to cards, identities and secure notes (default: off; [mapping guide](https://github.com/kjanat/kp2bw/blob/HEAD/docs/template-mapping.md)) | `KP2BW_MAP_TEMPLATES` | | `--template-map JSON` | Override template unread scheme's secret stays a hidden field (default: off) | `KP2BW_TOTP_PPS` | | `--migrate-uris` | Upgrade existing items: re-fold legacy `KP2A_URL*`/`AndroidApp` fields into login URIs, then exit CLI flag > environment variable > built-in default. ### Organization collections Bitwarden folders are personal-vault metadata. When importing into an organization, use `--bitwarden-collection auto` to create/use one collection per top-level KeePass folder, or `--bitwarden-collection nested` to create/use collections from full KeePass paths such as `Work/Servers`. Because folders only duplicate the collection tree in your personal vault, `--bitwarden-org` defaults to **not** creating personal folders. Items are filed only into collections. Pass `--folder` (or `KP2BW_CREATE_FOLDERS=1`) to restore the personal folder tree alongside the collections. ### URL handling A KeePass(XC) entry's additional URLs (`KP2A_URL`/`KP2A_URL_n`, plus the plainer `URL`/`URL_n` convention) and Android packages (`AndroidApp`/`AndroidApp_n`, incl. the no-underscore `AndroidApp1` variant) are migrated as real Bitwarden **login URIs**, so one login autofills across every site and app it covered in KeePass. Free-text URL labels (`API Url`, `Alt. URL`, `Website`, …) are left as custom fields, since folding those would wrongly autofill API endpoints and other metadata. Each URI gets a per-URI match mode reproducing KeePassXC's behaviour: a plain URL → **account default** (`match` unset, what Bitwarden itself writes; pass `--uri-match domain` to force base-domain and replicate KeePassXC's host-based matching), a double-quoted URL → **exact**, and a `*` wildcard → **starts-with** (trailing path) or **regex**. Non-web schemes (`keepassxc://`, `cmd://`, `kdbx://`, `file://`) and unresolved `{REF:…}` URLs are dropped. `--no-interpret-uri-syntax` disables the quote/wildcard interpretation and imports every URL as a plain string. Already imported before this existed? Two ways to upgrade: re-run a normal migration (the change is detected and the items are updated in place), or run `kp2bw --migrate-uris` without re-importing, a Bitwarden-only one-shot pass that re-folds the legacy fields into URIs on every existing item. Both honour `--uri-match`/`--interpret-uri-syntax` and `-o`/`-c`. The one-shot pass preserves stamped items edited in Bitwarden and establishes or refreshes `KP2BW_SYNC` on each migrated item. Too many subdomains autofilling together? Under base-domain matching, every login under `*.example.com` surfaces on any `example.com` subdomain. `kp2bw --report-uris keepass` (or `bitwarden`) prints a read-only collision report of registrable domains with multiple hosts, so you can see which entries pile up and switch those to **Host** match (or flip your Bitwarden account's default URI match detection to Host). It changes nothing; it just lists. Because kp2bw is KeePass-authoritative, a re-run would normally overwrite any difference on an existing item and quietly undo a title, note or URI you fixed in Bitwarden. It doesn't: every item kp2bw writes carries a `KP2BW_SYNC` content signature, and a re-run that finds an item's current content no longer matching that stamp knows *you* edited it (kp2bw's own writes restamp, so they never self-trip) and **preserves your edit**, listing it as `protected` in the summary. Pass `--force-update` (env `KP2BW_FORCE_UPDATE`) to make KeePass win regardless. Unchanged re-runs stay idempotent, and items imported before this existed are adopted normally on their first re-run. Every migrated item carries a plain-text `KP2BW_ID` custom field with the KeePass UUID kp2bw uses to match entries on re-runs so nothing duplicates. Once you're satisfied the migration is complete and you're ready to fully adopt Bitwarden, run ```bash kp2bw --strip-ids # personal vault; add -o/-c to scope to an org/collection ``` to remove tracking fields (including attachment associations and password-history tracking) from every migrated item and exit. No KeePass database is read. > [!WARNING] > This is **irreversible** and makes future migration re-runs unreliable. Without the stamp, a re-run can only match by > folder + name, so entries that share a folder and title may be duplicated or mismatched on a later migration. > `--strip-ids` confirms before changing anything (skip with `-y`). Only run it once you're truly done migrating. ### `.env` file kp2bw automatically loads a `.env` file, searched upward from the current working directory, so you can keep your settings (including the database path via `KP2BW_KEEPASS_FILE`) out of your shell history. Copy [`.env.example`] to `.env` and uncomment what you need: ```env KP2BW_KEEPASS_FILE=passwords.kdbx KP2BW_BITWARDEN_ORG=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 KP2BW_SKIP_EXPIRED=1 ``` Then just run `kp2bw` with no arguments. A real shell environment variable still overrides any value in `.env` (precedence is unchanged: CLI flag > env var > default), and `.env` is gitignored so secrets stay local. Only `KP2BW_*`, `BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR`, `VW_APPDATA_DIR` and `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` are loaded; executable and npm configuration variables must come from your shell. ## Troubleshooting Every run writes a full DEBUG log to a per-user file even when the console stays quiet, so a failed run leaves a complete record to share. On Windows that is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\kp2bw\logs`; override the file with `KP2BW_LOG_FILE` or the directory with `KP2BW_LOG_DIR`. CLI errors include the server's actual message, and a slow or dropped request no longer aborts the run. The summary counts failed entries, and a re-run picks up where it left off. Against a slow self-hosted server (e.g. Vaultwarden) where individual writes time out, raise the per-request HTTP timeout with `KP2BW_HTTP_TIMEOUT` (seconds; default 180, capped at 3600) to let those creates finish in the first place. Check the compatibility test results for the [Vaultwarden CLI][vw results] and the [Bitwarden CLI][bw results] with your server version. See [TROUBLESHOOTING]. ## Security See the [security policy](https://github.com/kjanat/kp2bw/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md). [^offload]: Bitwarden limits encrypted text field size; the available space depends on UTF-8 encoding and encryption overhead. kp2bw can offload any field exceeding that limit (hidden OTP secrets, passkey attributes, KeePass-protected fields) to a `.txt` file attachment instead of dropping it, so you don't lose data. This applies to long notes as well as custom fields. #!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

repository=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:?}
image="ghcr.io/${repository,,}"
version=${VERSION:?}
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -r "${tmp}"' EXIT

fail() {
	echo "$*" >&2
	exit 1
}

remote_digest() {
	if crane digest "$1" 2>"${tmp}/crane.err"; then
		return
	fi
	grep -q -E 'MANIFEST_UNKNOWN|404' "${tmp}/crane.err" || fail "Cannot inspect registry reference $1"
}

publish() {
	local directory=$1 cli arch tag tags candidate checksum previous vw="" bw=""
	for cli in vw bw; do
		if [[ ${cli} == bw ]] && ! [[ -f "${directory}/container-bw-amd64.tar" && -f "${directory}/container-bw-arm64.tar" ]]; then
			echo "bw images were not tested on every architecture; publishing vw images only" >&2
			continue
		fi
		tags=()
		for arch in amd64 arm64; do
			docker load --input "${directory}/container-${cli}-${arch}.tar"
			tag="${image}:build-${GITHUB_RUN_ID:?}-${cli}-${arch}"
			docker tag "kp2bw-production:${cli}-${arch}" "${tag}"
			docker push "${tag}"
			tags+=("${tag}")
		done
		candidate="${image}:build-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${cli}"
		docker buildx imagetools create --tag "${candidate}" "${tags[@]}"
		checksum=$(crane digest "${candidate}")
		previous=$(remote_digest "${image}:${version}-${cli}")
		[[ -z ${previous} || ${previous} == "${checksum}" ]] || fail "Refusing to overwrite different image ${image}:${version}-${cli}"
		[[ -n ${previous} ]] || crane tag "${image}@${checksum}" "${version}-${cli}"
		printf -v "${cli}" '%s' "${checksum}"
	done
	previous=$(remote_digest "${image}:${version}")
	[[ -z ${previous} || ${previous} == "${vw}" ]] || fail "Unsuffixed version already identifies a different image"
	[[ -n ${previous} ]] || crane tag "${image}@${vw}" "${version}"
	jq -n -S --arg vw "${vw}" --arg bw "${bw}" '{vw: $vw} + if $bw == "" then {} else {bw: $bw} end' >image-digests.json
	printf 'image=%s\nvw=%s\nbw=%s\n' "${image}" "${vw}" "${bw}" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?}"
}

verify() {
	local vw bw pair reference checksum attempt actual arch pairs
	vw=$(jq -r .vw image-digests.json)
	bw=$(jq -r '.bw // empty' image-digests.json)
	mkdir "${tmp}/docker"
	pairs=("-vw ${vw}" " ${vw}")
	[[ -z ${bw} ]] || pairs+=("-bw ${bw}")
	for pair in "${pairs[@]}"; do
		reference="${image}:${version}${pair% *}"
		checksum=${pair#* }
		for attempt in {1..30}; do
			if actual=$(DOCKER_CONFIG="${tmp}/docker" crane digest "${reference}" 2>"${tmp}/crane.err"); then
				[[ ${actual} == "${checksum}" ]] || fail "Published digest differs: ${reference}"
				break
			fi
			((attempt < 30)) || fail "Image is not publicly available: ${reference}; check package visibility"
			sleep 10
		done
	done
	for checksum in "${vw}" ${bw:+"${bw}"}; do
		for arch in amd64 arm64; do
			docker --config "${tmp}/docker" pull --platform "linux/${arch}" "${image}@${checksum}"
			docker image rm "${image}@${checksum}"
		done
	done
}

promote() {
	local vw bw current installed newest major minor cli checksum tag
	[[ ${STABLE:?} == true ]] || return 0
	vw=$(jq -r .vw image-digests.json)
	bw=$(jq -r '.bw // empty' image-digests.json)
	current=$(remote_digest "${image}:latest")
	if [[ -n ${current} ]]; then
		installed=$(crane config --platform linux/amd64 "${image}@${current}" | jq -r '.config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.version"]')
		newest=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "${installed}" "${version}" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
		[[ ${newest} == "${version}" ]] || fail "Refusing to move stable aliases to an older release"
	fi
	major=${version%%.*}
	minor=${version#*.}
	minor=${minor%%.*}
	for cli in vw bw; do
		checksum=${!cli}
		[[ -n ${checksum} ]] || continue
		for tag in "${cli}" "${major}-${cli}" "${major}.${minor}-${cli}"; do
			crane tag "${image}@${checksum}" "${tag}"
		done
	done
	for tag in latest "${major}" "${major}.${minor}"; do
		crane tag "${image}@${vw}" "${tag}"
	done
}

case ${1:-} in
	publish) publish "${2:-images}" ;;
	verify) verify ;;
	promote) promote ;;
	*) fail "Usage: release-images.sh publish [DIRECTORY] | verify | promote" ;;
esac

"""Exercise the production image, including state persistence and termination."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from pykeepass import create_database


def main() -> None:
    image = os.environ["KP2BW_CONTAINER_IMAGE"]
    expected_version = os.environ["KP2BW_CONTAINER_VERSION"]
    expected_bw = os.environ["KP2BW_CONTAINER_BW_VERSION"]
    expected_package = os.environ["KP2BW_CONTAINER_CLI_PACKAGE"]
    cli = "vw" if expected_package == "@kjanat/vaultwarden-cli" else "bw"
    cli_options = ["--nointeraction"] if cli == "vw" else []
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    volume = f"kp2bw-image-test-{uuid4().hex}"
    stopped = f"{volume}-stop"
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(
        KP2BW_KEEPASS_PASSWORD="synthetic",
        KP2BW_BITWARDEN_PASSWORD="TestMasterPassword123!",
        BW_PASSWORD="TestMasterPassword123!",
        KP2BW_YES="true",
        BW_NOINTERACTION="true",
    )

    def run(
        args: list[str],
        *,
        allowed: tuple[int, ...] = (0,),
        timeout: int = 180,
        stderr: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        result = subprocess.run(
            args,
            env=env,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        if result.returncode not in allowed:
            # Never print login/unlock output or credential-bearing command lines.
            raise AssertionError(f"Container test command exited {result.returncode}")
        return (result.stderr if stderr else result.stdout).strip()

    run(["docker", "volume", "create", volume])
    try:
        inspection = json.loads(run(["docker", "image", "inspect", image]))[0]
        assert inspection["Config"]["WorkingDir"] == "/w"
        assert inspection["Architecture"] == os.environ["KP2BW_CONTAINER_ARCH"]
        labels = inspection["Config"]["Labels"]
        assert labels["io.kp2bw.cli.package"] == expected_package
        assert labels["io.kp2bw.cli.version"] == expected_bw
        assert labels["org.opencontainers.image.version"] == expected_version
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            source = Path(directory)
            source.chmod(0o755)
            keyfile = source / "key.key"
            keyfile.write_bytes(bytes(range(32)))
            db = create_database(
                source / "vault.kdbx", password="synthetic", keyfile=str(keyfile)
            )
            entry = db.add_entry(
                db.root_group, "Container round trip", "user", "password"
            )
            entry.notes = "production image"
            entry.add_attachment(db.add_binary(b"container attachment"), "file.bin")
            db.save()
            for path in source.iterdir():
                path.chmod(0o644)
            base = [
                "docker",
                "run",
                "--rm",
                "--network",
                "host",
                "--mount",
                f"type=volume,src={volume},dst=/data",
                "--mount",
                f"type=bind,src={source},dst=/source,readonly",
                "--mount",
                f"type=bind,src={root / 'tests/fixtures/vaultwarden-certs/cert.pem'},dst=/cert.pem,readonly",
                "--env",
                "NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/cert.pem",
                "--env",
                "KP2BW_KEEPASS_PASSWORD",
                "--env",
                "KP2BW_BITWARDEN_PASSWORD",
                "--env",
                "BW_PASSWORD",
                "--env",
                "KP2BW_YES",
                "--env",
                "BW_NOINTERACTION",
            ]
            assert "Import KeePass" in run([*base, image, "--help"])
            assert expected_version in run([*base, image, "--version"])

#
# Images/binaries are synthesized in-process (no committed binary, no Pillow) so
# the seed is one self-contained text file.  Bytes must be *byte-stable* across
# machines: the interpreter ships zlib-ng, whose ``zlib.compress`` output is not
# reproducible, so the PNG is built from stored (uncompressed) DEFLATE blocks

def zlib_stored(raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    """A zlib stream of *stored* (uncompressed) DEFLATE blocks -- byte-stable."""
    out = bytearray(b"\x78\x01")  # zlib header (CM=deflate, no preset dict)
    total = len(raw)
    start = 0
    while True:
        block = raw[start : start + 0xFFFF]
        start += len(block)
        final = 1 if start >= total else 0
        out.append(final)  # BFINAL bit + BTYPE=00 (stored)
        length = len(block)
        out += struct.pack("<HH", length, length ^ 0xFFFF)  # LEN + NLEN
        out += block
        if final:
            break
    out += struct.pack(">I", zlib.adler32(raw) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return bytes(out)


def png(width: int, height: int, rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> bytes:
    """A minimal valid 8-bit truecolor PNG with byte-stable contents."""

    def chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
        body = tag + data
        return (
            struct.pack(">I", len(data))
            + body
            + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(body) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        )

    signature = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)  # 8-bit RGB
    row = b"\x00" + bytes(rgb) * width  # filter byte 0 + pixels
    idat = zlib_stored(row * height)
    return signature + chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr) + chunk(b"IDAT", idat) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")

    if bank_totp.startswith("otpauth://") or "GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ" not in bank_totp:

    if find_field(bank, "branch")["type"] != 0:
        raise AssertionError("Bank Account 'branch' should be a text field (type 0)")

    # Hex secret + SHA-256 + 8 digits -> otpauth URI carrying those params.
    ssh_totp = make_login(item_by_name(vault, "SSH Box"))["totp"] or ""
    if not ssh_totp.startswith("otpauth://totp/"):
        raise AssertionError(f"SSH Box TOTP should be an otpauth URI: {ssh_totp!r}")
    if "algorithm=SHA256" not in ssh_totp or "digits=8" not in ssh_totp:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"SSH Box TOTP missing SHA256/8-digit config: {ssh_totp!r}"
        )

    # KeePassXC otp passthrough keeps the original secret.
    xc_totp = make_login(item_by_name(vault, "KeePassXC OTP"))["totp"] or ""
    if (

    hotp = item_by_name(vault, "HOTP Legacy")
    if make_login(hotp)["totp"]:
        raise AssertionError("HOTP Legacy must not produce a login.totp")
    if find_field(hotp, "HmacOtp-Secret-Base32")["type"] != 1:
        raise AssertionError("HOTP secret should be kept as a hidden field (type 1)")

    files = item_by_name(vault, "Has Files")
    by_name = {att["fileName"]: att["sha256"] for att in files["attachments"]}
    if by_name.get("logo.png") != hashlib.sha256(LOGO_PNG).hexdigest():
        raise AssertionError("logo.png attachment bytes did not round-trip")
    if by_name.get("payload.bin") != hashlib.sha256(BLOB).hexdigest():
        raise AssertionError("payload.bin attachment bytes did not round-trip")

    # Unicode credentials survive the round-trip intact.
    cafe = make_login(item_by_name(vault, "Café ☕ Ünïcødé"))
    if cafe["username"] != "café-user" or cafe["password"] != "naïve-pø$$wörd":
        raise AssertionError("Unicode credentials were corrupted in migration")

    # A >10k custom field is offloaded to a <key>.txt attachment *only* -- never
    # also stored inline, which would duplicate it and can hit the field-size
    # limit (#21). The short field beside it still migrates inline.
    long_field = item_by_name(vault, "Long Field")
    long_atts = {att["fileName"]: att["sha256"] for att in long_field["attachments"]}
    if (
        long_atts.get("recovery_codes.txt")
        != hashlib.sha256(LONG_FIELD.encode("UTF-8")).hexdigest()
    ):
        raise AssertionError(
            "Long custom field was not offloaded to recovery_codes.txt intact"
        )
    if any(field["name"] == "recovery_codes" for field in long_field["fields"]):
        raise AssertionError(
            "Long custom field must not also be emitted as an inline field (#21)"
        )
    if find_field(long_field, "hint")["value"] != "see recovery_codes.txt":
        raise AssertionError("Short field beside the long one should stay inline")

    # Additional URLs / Android packages fold into login.uris with per-URI match
    # modes; the KP2A_URL*/URL_*/AndroidApp* custom fields must NOT survive, and
    # the keepassxc:// value must be dropped. (Runs unconditionally, so the

    multi = item_by_name(vault, "Multi URL")
    multi_uri_list = make_login(multi)["uris"]
    multi_uri_values = [uri["uri"] for uri in multi_uri_list]
    if len(set(multi_uri_values)) != len(multi_uri_values):
        raise AssertionError(f"Multi URL has duplicate URIs: {multi_uri_values}")
    multi_uris = {uri["uri"]: uri["match"] for uri in multi_uri_list}
    expected_multi_uris: dict[str, int | None] = {
        "https://multi.example": None,
        "https://alt-one.example": None,
        "https://alt-two.example": None,
        "https://alt-three.example": None,
        "androidapp://com.multi.app": None,
        "androidapp://com.multi.other": None,
        "https://exact.example/login": 3,  # quoted -> exact
        "https://multi.example/area/": 2,  # trailing wildcard -> starts-with
        "https://.*\\.wild\\.example/.*": 4,  # host wildcard -> regex
    }
    if multi_uris != expected_multi_uris:
        raise AssertionError(f"Multi URL uris/match wrong: {multi_uris}")
    leftover = [
        name
        for field in multi["fields"]
        if is_url_attribute_key(name := field["name"] or "")
    ]
    if leftover:
        raise AssertionError(f"Multi URL still carries legacy URL fields: {leftover}")

"""Live smoke test for invoking an npm-installed ``bw`` shim on Windows.

Run by the ``windows-bw-cmd`` CI job, which installs the Bitwarden CLI via npm
(producing ``bw.cmd`` + ``bw.ps1`` with no ``bw.exe``). It proves the two
Windows-specific mechanisms kp2bw relies on, neither of which can be checked
off-Windows:

1. ``resolve_cli_command`` resolves the npm shim and the wrapped command actually
   runs (``bw --version``).
2. ``terminate_serve`` tears down a process launched through a ``cmd.exe``
   wrapper together with its descendants (``taskkill /F /T``), freeing the port
   — a plain ``terminate()`` would orphan the real child behind the wrapper.

``bw serve`` itself requires a logged-in vault ("You are not logged in."), which
isn't available on CI, so the teardown is exercised against a ``cmd.exe -> node``
tree that holds a port — the same process shape ``bw.cmd -> node`` produces.

On non-Windows hosts this is a no-op so the pytest adapter can import it safely.
"""

import os
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from kp2bw.bw_serve import resolve_cli_command, terminate_serve


def free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return int(s.getsockname()[1])


def port_accepting(port: int) -> bool:
    """True if something is listening on *port* (a TCP connect succeeds)."""
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.settimeout(1)
        try:
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
        except OSError:
            return False
        return True


def port_is_free(port: int) -> bool:
    """True if nothing holds *port* (i.e. it can be bound again)."""
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 0)
        try:
            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
        except OSError:
            return False
        return True


def assert_resolves_and_runs() -> None:
    # A supplied migration directory must not shadow the installed CLI.
    original_cwd = Path.cwd()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="kp2bw-cli-shadow-") as directory:
        project = Path(directory)
        for name in ("vw", "bw", "npx"):
            (project / (name + ".cmd")).write_text("@exit /b 73\n")
        try:
            os.chdir(project)
            with patch.dict(
                os.environ,
                {
                    "PATH": str(project)
                    + os.pathsep
                    + "."
                    + os.pathsep
                    + os.environ["PATH"]
                },
            ):
                argv, cwd = resolve_cli_command()
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [*argv, "--version"],
                    cwd=cwd,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    check=False,
                    timeout=60,
                )
                assert result.returncode == 0, (
                    "Migration directory shadowed installed CLI"
                )
        finally:
            os.chdir(original_cwd)
    argv, cwd = resolve_cli_command()
    print(f"resolve_cli_command -> {argv!r} (cwd={cwd!r})")
    # npm provides bw.cmd (+ bw.ps1, no bw.exe), so we expect a wrapped shim;
    # accept a native exe too in case the runner image ever ships one.
    launcher = [arg for arg in argv if arg != "--nointeraction"]
    runnable = (
        len(launcher) == 1 and launcher[0].lower().endswith((".exe", ".com"))
    ) or (len(launcher) > 1 and launcher[-1].lower().endswith((".cmd", ".bat", ".ps1")))
    if not runnable:
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected bw resolution: {argv!r}")

    result = subprocess.run(
        [*argv, "--version"],
        check=False,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        cwd=cwd,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"bw --version via shim failed (exit {result.returncode}): "
            f"{result.stderr.strip()!r}"
        )
    if not result.stdout.strip():
        raise AssertionError("bw --version via shim produced no output")
    print(f"CLI --version -> {result.stdout.strip()}")
    help_result = subprocess.run(
        [*argv, "serve", "--help"],
        cwd=cwd,
        check=False,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )
    assert help_result.returncode == 0, "Selected CLI cannot run serve --help"


def assert_wrapped_teardown_frees_port() -> None:
    port = free_port()
    comspec = os.environ.get("COMSPEC", "cmd.exe")
    # cmd.exe -> node holding a port mirrors how bw.cmd -> node would behave.
    # A naive terminate() kills only cmd.exe and leaves node holding the port;
    # terminate_serve(via_shell=True) must take the whole tree down.
    node_script = (
        "const net=require('net');"
        "const srv=net.createServer();"
        f"srv.listen({port}, '127.0.0.1');"
        "setTimeout(()=>{}, 600000);"
    )
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        [comspec, "/d", "/c", "node", "-e", node_script],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    )

    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if proc.poll() is not None:
                stderr = b""
                if proc.stderr is not None:
                    stderr = proc.stderr.read()
                raise AssertionError(
                    f"wrapped child exited before binding (code {proc.returncode}): "
                    f"{stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip()!r}"
                )
            if port_accepting(port):
                break
            time.sleep(0.25)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("wrapped child never started listening within 30s")
    finally:
        terminate_serve(proc, via_shell=True, timeout=15)

    if proc.poll() is None:
        raise AssertionError("terminate_serve left the cmd.exe wrapper running")

    # The decisive check: taskkill /T must have killed node too. If it were
    # orphaned it would still hold the port and a fresh bind would fail.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if port_is_free(port):
            return
        time.sleep(0.25)
    raise AssertionError(
        f"port {port} still held after teardown — the wrapped child was orphaned"
    )


def main() -> None:
    if os.name != "nt":
        print("windows bw .cmd smoke: skipped (not Windows)")
        return
    assert_resolves_and_runs()
    assert_wrapped_teardown_frees_port()
    print("windows bw .cmd smoke passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
